definition: Physical installed-Windows acceptance only; headless/hosted CI does not change status.

requirements.manual_acceptance: Create a synthetic nested report directly in Modules; edit content without using Editor
Expand and move three levels; visually verify continuous parent-child connectors
Build and reopen a deeply nested synthetic report, documenting any explicit safety bound
Resize viewport with long Unicode text, images and tables; no clipping or nested scrollbars
Interleave text, photo, table and submodule; verify visual and exported ordering
Confirm no permanent second module navigator or independent editable tree
Edit selected multilingual paragraph in place with caret and formatting intact
Rename a module directly on its branch header; Editor and TOC update
Import safe synthetic images and verify visible thumbnails and captions in location
Crop, rotate, annotate and replace a synthetic image; export shows intended placement
Edit table cell, add/remove row and column in branch; undo and reopen
Insert each block type at beginning, middle and end of a nested module
Verify toolbar appears only for active text and selected formatting highlights
Drag modules and blocks across parents; save/reopen preserves IDs and children
Observe Before, After and Inside preview and reject Inside on noncontainers
Independently collapse and expand a parent and a nested submodule
Move selected module up/down via controls and keyboard alternatives
Duplicate, delete and outdent; undo preserves original and duplicate gets new IDs
Save and reopen after collapse state changes; verify state without reordering data
Validate collapsed descendant counts for modules, text, photos and tables
Focus a nested subtree then exit; preserve selection and source hierarchy
Zoom, pan and fit with mouse/touchpad; verify document print geometry unchanged
Search titles, body and captions within collapsed branches; reveal the selected hit
Right-click each block type; verify available actions and disabled invalid actions
Resize text, photo and table presentation at multiple DPI scales with no clipped data
Drag synthetic PNG/JPEG from Windows Explorer into branch and verify source untouched
Paste native bitmap and file list from Windows clipboard at chosen insertion point
Edit same block in Branch and Editor with draft conflict/Apply/Undo and stable IDs
Validate TOC/numbering from hierarchy and Conclusions last after moves and reopen
Use Editor precision page controls and verify same committed content in Modules
Verify Gallery shares photo assets; open independent user-operated ChatGPT tab
Verify PDF proof and DOCX/PDF after committed edits; distinguish pagination limits
Manually copy selected branch text into ChatGPT site and paste a reviewed response; browser image copy/download remains manual and separate from Gallery import
